notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR22: on an implicit transfer from the previous sequential paragraph, DEBUG-LINE identifies the previous statement, DEBUG-NAME contains procedure-name-1 and "DEBUG-CONTENTS contains 'FALL THROUGH'". DispatchEmitter.EmitDispatchMethod's case epilogue emits EmitDebugCause(FallThrough, the paragraph's last line) before __pc = i + 1, and the next case's __RunDebug populates DEBUG-ITEM (DebugItem.ContentsFor gives FALL THROUGH). Probes at 85: fall-through inside a PERFORM PB THRU PD range across an empty paragraph (DEBUG-LINE 27, the DISPLAY in PB), fall-through into a section-name subject (line 33) and into a paragraph of that section (line 36); COBOL0902 at 2002/2023. The witness checks FALL THROUGH, the name and DEBUG-LINE stability.
